posts.title: re: Going to the Movies Alone
posts.description: Do it! Try it once. At least for me, it's a very enjoyable experience. When I watch movies in theaters, I don't really like talking to anyone during the movie so going alone prevents that. The first time, it was a little weird at first mostly during commercials, but after that, I always enjoyed it.
